investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: The alert was triggered by the deletion of a virtual network peering in the production resource group rg-baltic-prod-core by andrus.kivi@globalcorp.ee from Tallinn (194.126.101.99). The user’s job title (Regional Logistics Coordinator) is not consistent with making infrastructure changes, and the action occurred at 00:50 local time, which is outside normal working hours. This activity is part of a rapid sequence of configuration and network changes in the same production resource group, increasing potential impact; given the role mismatch, out-of-hours timing, and production scope, the activity is considered High Priority.
